dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト) - GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL based system used in Japanese medical clinics
evidence: COPY CPCOMMONDAT2.INC / CPSYUNOU.INC / CPPTHKNINF.INC etc - ORCA-specific copybooks
COPY MCPAREA / MCPDATA.INC / COMMON-SPA - ORCA DB access pattern
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM PIC X(256)
No EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL - uses ORCA middleware calls
SELECT ... ASSIGN BD00801PARA ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED - ISAM file access typical of GnuCOBOL/ORCA

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance claim (receipt/レセプト) statistics CSV generation - daily patient visit statistics (日計表) for medical billing
purpose.summary: ORCBD999 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that generates a daily statistics CSV file (nikkei_.csv) for patient visits and insurance billing data. It reads from an indexed receipt/payment file (BD00801), processes patient insurance information, and outputs a CSV with columns for patient name, insurance points, co-payments, and various insurance categories. The program is part of the CSVサンプル (CSV sample) statistics subsystem introduced for Heisei 20 (April 2008) onwards.

notable_features: OCCURS 11 for SUM-AREA aggregation across insurance categories
REDEFINES on ISAM key for multiple access patterns
24 COPY statements using ORCA-specific copybooks (.INC files)
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM for shell/job invocation
UNSTRING on COMMAND-PARAM for parameter parsing
CSV output generation with Japanese column headers
CONST-AREA with date constants for insurance law revision dates (20070401, 20080401)
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese) but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in comments. The program logic is clearly readable. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 73064 bytes total (1831 lines). The ORCA system is a well-known open-source Japanese medical receipt software maintained by JMA, compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux.
